title: Method and apparatus for mounting electrical components that employs a compensation element

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to the carrier plate extending around it
A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip
Vacuum handling apparatus with suction plate and grip unit combined
features.quote: An apparatus for mounting a component onto a substrate of an electrical assembly, comprising: a mounting head member and a retaining device attached to said mounting head member for mounting said component onto said substrate
features.note: The reference describes an apparatus for mounting components, which implies handling, and includes a retaining device (similar to a suction plate) and a mounting head (similar to a grip unit), but it does not explicitly mention a vacuum handling apparatus or a suction plate.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate

claims.note: The reference describes an apparatus for mounting electrical components, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.
The reference describes a mounting head member and retaining device, not a housing with a grip portion and an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not mention exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor a sound-damping device.
This reference discusses damping members for spring forces in component mounting, not sound-damping devices in a grip portion.
This reference discusses damping members for spring forces in component mounting, not sound-damping material lining a grip portion.
This reference describes an apparatus for mounting electrical components, not a grip unit with a vacuum generating device arranged in a housing portion.
This reference describes an apparatus for mounting electrical components, not a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or lining thereof.
This reference describes an apparatus for mounting electrical components, not a grip unit with housing portions and air outlets.
This reference describes an apparatus for mounting electrical components, not a grip unit with an air collection device or air collection screw.
This reference describes an apparatus for mounting electrical components, not a grip unit with air baffles for guiding exhaust air.
This reference describes an apparatus for mounting electrical components, not a grip unit with a battery coupling point.
The reference does not discuss air baffles, exhaust air, or battery coupling points.
The reference describes an apparatus for mounting electrical components, not a vacuum handling apparatus.
The reference does not describe a suction plate, carrier plate, or a seal fastened to a carrier plate.
The reference does not describe a grip unit as defined in claim 1 of the subject invention.

claims.quote: An apparatus according to claim 4 wherein said damping member comprises a coupling member.
claims.note: The reference discloses a coupling member as part of a damping member, but not specifically a coupling device for releasably connecting a grip unit and a suction plate.
The reference does not disclose a grip unit with a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber to generate a vacuum for lifting an object.

overall.why: The reference describes an apparatus for mounting electrical components using a compensating element with a spring and damping member, which is a different technical problem and solution than the subject invention's vacuum handling apparatus with a sound-damped grip.
